description: ADR 0011 addendum (accepted 2026-11-23): where alerts go. Get-AlertDestinations reads config alert_destinations (entries separated by ';', each 'chat:<user principal name>', 'channel:<team id>/<channel id>' or 'email:<address>') and the old alert_recipient, which is read as one more chat: entry. Kinds are case-insensitive; addresses and team ids are lower-cased; a channel id is kept as given. Repeats are shown once, first one kept. A bad entry is kept as 'invalid' with a reason, so the handler can report it and still send to the others. All addresses are fictional (example.org).

parse.note: nothing configured: no destination, the handler records a failure
team id lower-cased, channel id kept as given
spaces, empty entries and a trailing ';' are ignored; order kept
alert_recipient is added as one chat: entry after the list
repeats, in any case, are sent once
the same person by chat and by email are two destinations

expected: invalid:sms:+440000000000 (unknown kind 'sms': use chat:, channel: or email:)
invalid:a@example.org (no kind: start with chat:, channel: or email:)
invalid:email:not an address (not an email address)
invalid:channel:Sales team/19:x@thread.tacv2 (team id is not a GUID)
parse.note: names aren't accepted: they change, ids don't

expected: invalid:sms:1 (unknown kind 'sms': use chat:, channel: or email:)
parse.note: a bad entry doesn't stop the others
the address rules a flow expression can check: one @ with text before it, a dotted domain not starting or ending with a dot

expected: invalid:sms:1 (unknown kind 'sms': use chat:, channel: or email:)
invalid:SMS:1 (unknown kind 'sms': use chat:, channel: or email:)
parse.note: a bad entry is shown once only when its text is identical
a team id one character short; a channel id with nothing after 19:
